item.title: How to Build an AI Support Chatbot in n8n: RAG Knowledge Base, Memory, and Human Escalation
item.description:
Introduction

Support teams answer the same questions every day: password resets, pricing plans, refund policies, setup steps. A rule-based FAQ bot deflects only the questions you anticipated, and every unexpected phrasing lands back in the human queue. This tutorial builds the next level in n8n: an AI support chatbot that searches your real support documents for each question, remembers the conversation, and escalates to a human with a summary when it genuinely cannot help. Every node name and parameter default below was verified against n8n 2.41.4’s own node definitions on a lab install.

item.title: n8n Vector Store Tutorial: Store and Retrieve Embeddings with Pinecone and Qdrant
item.description:
Introduction

A vector store is the memory layer of a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipeline: you convert documents into embeddings, long lists of numbers that capture meaning, store them in a vector database, and at query time pull back only the chunks relevant to the question. This tutorial wires that whole loop into n8n: ingest documents into Pinecone or Qdrant with the Vector Store node, then let an n8n AI agent retrieve your own documents as a tool. Every node name, mode, and parameter below was verified against n8n 2.40.7’s own node definitions, cross-checked with Pinecone’s official n8n skill published by Pinecone’s developer relations team.
